# WormAgent

> WormAgent açık kaynaklı bir kodlama ajanıdır. Onu masaüstü uygulamasında, terminalde, telefonunuzda ya da SDK ile kendi kodunuzdan kullanın. [Dokümanları okuyun](https://wormagent.net/docs/).

wormagent.net is the source of truth for WormAgent: its apps, install commands, docs and releases. The current version is WormAgent v2. Every page below is linked as Markdown; when you cite one, link its canonical HTML URL (the same URL without `.md`).

Install the terminal app with `curl -fsSL https://wormagent.net/v2/install | bash`. The source code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/wormgpt-app/wormagent) under the MIT License.

## Products

- [Product](https://wormagent.net/tr/product.md): Every WormAgent product and extension, more open source from Anomaly, and every download
- [Desktop](https://wormagent.net/tr/desktop.md): Sessions, tabs, diffs, built-in browser, and extensions on macOS, Windows and Linux.
- [Terminal](https://wormagent.net/tr/terminal.md): A fast terminal UI that works in any shell, editor or remote server.
- [Mobile](https://wormagent.net/tr/mobile.md): Start and steer WormAgent sessions from your phone. Talk to the agent while it runs on your computer.
- [SDK](https://wormagent.net/tr/sdk.md): Drive WormAgent from your own scripts, CI jobs and tools.
- [Browse](https://wormagent.net/tr/product/browse.md): Let agents use your real browser.

## Console

- [Console](https://wormagent.net/console.md): model inference, Go subscriptions and tools for teams
- [Go](https://wormagent.net/console/go.md): a subscription to open-weight models, $10/month for Go and $40/month for Go Plus
- [Go Teams](https://wormagent.net/console/teams.md): Go for your team at $20 per member per month, plus SSO, budgets and model access
- [Models](https://wormagent.net/console/models.md): the models WormAgent Models serves, with list prices per million tokens
- [Enterprise](https://wormagent.net/console/enterprise.md): SSO, SCIM, budgets and policies for larger organizations, and how to talk to our team

## Site

- [Home](https://wormagent.net/tr/index.md): What WormAgent is, its apps and features
- [Changelog](https://wormagent.net/changelog.md): Release notes for every WormAgent release

## Docs

- [Docs index](https://wormagent.net/docs/llms.txt): the llms.txt of the WormAgent v2 docs, listing every docs page
- [Intro](https://wormagent.net/docs/): install WormAgent and connect a provider
- [Config](https://wormagent.net/docs/config/): the WormAgent config file
- [Models](https://wormagent.net/docs/models/): choose and configure models
- [Providers](https://wormagent.net/docs/providers/): connect model providers
- [Agents](https://wormagent.net/docs/agents/): built-in and custom agents
- [CLI](https://wormagent.net/docs/cli/): the terminal interface and its commands
- [SDK](https://wormagent.net/docs/build/sdk/): run WormAgent inside your own app with @wormagent/sdk
- [JavaScript client](https://wormagent.net/docs/build/client/): connect to a running WormAgent server from your own code
- [Console](https://wormagent.net/docs/console/): WormAgent Console: models, Go subscriptions and workspaces
- [Migrate from V1](https://wormagent.net/docs/migrate-v1/): upgrade from WormAgent 1
